name: Rope Spear
tooltip: A spearhead tied to rope; throw it to pierce, then reel toward the mark.

concept.fantasy: A compact spearhead knotted to a coil of rope, used like a hooked lance that snaps back to hand.
concept.mergeLogic: The Spear parent contributes an 8-damage melee spear projectile with owner-checked hit behavior, while the Rope parent contributes consumable stack identity and tether logic.
concept.weirdTwist: On impact, the rope goes taut and yanks the wielder a short distance toward the target.

sourceRolePreservation.itemA: melee spear projectile and close owner-checked hit identity
sourceRolePreservation.itemB: rope material, stackable consumable texture, and tether pull behavior

params.projectileMotion: snaps out, pierces, then reels back

visualIntent.item: short spearhead with a coiled rope grip and dangling tether
visualIntent.projectile: spearhead flying on a thin rope line
visualIntent.impact: rope line snaps taut with a small dust puff
visualIntent.vfxIntent: thin rope tether, quick dust on hit, no wide aura
visualIntent.vfxAvoid: large explosions, magic beams, broad radial effects

runtimePlan.sourceReading: Raw fields show Spear as an 8-damage melee item with item.shoot=49, ownerHitCheck=true, tileCollide=false, and penetrate=-1, while Rope is a consumable stackable material with useTurn=true and createTile=213.
runtimePlan.balanceIntent: Moderate damage and use time with finite pierce; the pull reward trades safe spacing for commitment after a hit.

visual.itemPrompt: Small iron spearhead haft wrapped with brown rope coil, short dangling cord loop.
visual.projectilePrompt: Flying spearhead trailing a thin taught rope line back to the player.
visual.impactPrompt: Tiny rope-fiber dust burst where the spearhead anchors, with the tether briefly glowing taut.
visual.notes: Keep the tether readable but thin; avoid large particle clouds.
